command:
set -e; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; state(){ adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry 2>/dev/null | grep -m1 'mCallState=' | cut -d= -f2 | tr -d '[:space:]'; }; voice_block(){ adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys audio | sed -n '/- STREAM_VOICE_CALL:/,/Volume Group: AUDIO_STREAM_VOICE_CALL/p'; }; BT_BEFORE=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell settings get global bluetooth_on | tr -d '[:space:]'); cleanup(){ python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" hangup >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 0 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 8 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; if [ "$BT_BEFORE" = "1" ]; then adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd bluetooth_manager enable >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; for i in $(seq 1 40); do [ "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell settings get global bluetooth_on | tr -d '[:space:]')" = "1" ] && break; sleep 0.25; done; fi; }; trap cleanup EXIT; test "$(state)" = 0; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell ps -A -o USER,PID,NAME | grep -E '^shell[[:space:]]+[0-9]+[[:space:]]+shizuku_server$'; if [ "$BT_BEFORE" = 1 ]; then adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd bluetooth_manager disable; fi; for i in $(seq 1 40); do [ "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell settings get global bluetooth_on | tr -d '[:space:]')" = 0 ] && break; sleep 0.25; done; test "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell settings get global bluetooth_on | tr -d '[:space:]')" = 0; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 0; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 8 || true; PRE=$(voice_block); printf '%s
' "$PRE" | grep -q 'Muted: true'; printf '%s
' "$PRE" | grep -q 'streamVolume:0'; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" dial 510100100; ACTIVE=0; for i in $(seq 1 40); do S=$(state); echo live_call_state=$S; if [ "$S" = 2 ]; then ACTIVE=1; break; fi; sleep 1; done; test "$ACTIVE" = 1; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 0; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 8 || true; ACTIVE_AUDIO=$(voice_block); printf '%s
' "$ACTIVE_AUDIO" | grep -q 'Muted: true'; printf '%s
' "$ACTIVE_AUDIO" | grep -q 'streamVolume:0'; printf '%s
' "$ACTIVE_AUDIO" | grep -q 'Devices: earpiece(1)'; echo silent_audio_guard_active=true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell "sh -c 'sleep 20; input keyevent KEYCODE_ENDCALL; cmd audio adj-mute 0; cmd audio adj-mute 8' >/dev/null 2>&1 </dev/null &"; adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -c; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am force-stop pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge; START_OUTPUT=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am start -W -n pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge/.DiagnosticProbeActivity --ez run_shizuku_endpoint_close_probe true 2>&1); printf '%s
' "$START_OUTPUT"; printf '%s
' "$START_OUTPUT" | grep -q 'Status: ok'; RESULT=''; for i in $(seq 1 120); do RESULT=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -d -v raw -s AiCallBridge:I '*:S' 2>/dev/null || true); if printf '%s
' "$RESULT" | grep -q 'endpoint_close_fail_safe_ok=true'; then break; fi; sleep 0.1; done; printf '%s
' "$RESULT"; printf '%s
' "$RESULT" | grep -q 'downlink_close_ok=true'; printf '%s
' "$RESULT" | grep -q 'uplink_close_ok=true'; printf '%s
' "$RESULT" | grep -q 'downlink_close_timing_ok=true'; printf '%s
' "$RESULT" | grep -q 'uplink_close_timing_ok=true'; printf '%s
' "$RESULT" | grep -q 'endpoint_close_fail_safe_ok=true'; test "$(state)" = 2; echo endpoint_close_rx_tx_physical_green=true; cleanup; trap - EXIT; for i in $(seq 1 20); do [ "$(state)" = 0 ] && break; sleep 0.25; done; test "$(state)" = 0; test "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell settings get global bluetooth_on | tr -d '[:space:]')" = "$BT_BEFORE"; echo milestone_d_endpoint_close_physical_green=true
